description: This file declares the NotificationHandler class and related functions for handling notifications within the host interface module of a TR-069 management system. It includes callback registration, notification queuing, and various push notification methods related to device management and deep sleep status.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and sending various notifications related to device management and system events within the host interface.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: GetNotificationQueue
methods.description: Provides access to the queue used for notification messages.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked upon notification updates.

methods.name: pushValueChangeNotification
methods.description: Pushes a notification indicating a value change event.

methods.name: pushKeyValueNotification
methods.description: Pushes a key-value pair notification to a specified destination.

methods.name: push_device_mgmt_notifications
methods.description: Pushes device management related notifications with parameters such as delay, start time, download status, and system ready time.

methods.name: push_device_deepsleep_notifications
methods.description: Pushes deep sleep status notifications with associated timestamp.

methods.name: pushNotification
methods.description: Private method to enqueue a notification given a destination and payload.
